description: BOSTON—Senator Nick Collins and Representative David Biele announced that the Fiscal Year 2027 state budget, recently signed into law by Governor Maura Healey, delivers significant resources for South Boston with investments in public safety, education, healthcare, workforce development, senior services, and waterfront resilience. title: Senator Collins, Representative Biele Deliver Over $1.4 Million for South Boston in FY27 State Budget - Senator Nick Collins
